title: CoreS3-SE 0.1.30 selected instrument screenshots
author: Jonathan Yantis
selection: Five explicitly selected screens from finite development checks of the installed CoreSE0.1.30 app. All five are on-device production-renderer frames of the live model, leaving the visible instrument page unchanged. The instrument frame was selected from a later check with a current source and TZ; earlier source gaps and unselected completed-LCD observations remain in the local record.

previous_edition.note: Previous images and manifest remain in Git at this edition; their hashes are not rewritten.

limits: Not optical photographs or calibrated UTC/physical PPS accuracy evidence.
P95/P99/MAX are sampled internal errors against later authenticated BLE witnesses; P99 hold seconds describe a sampled-prefix population, not continuous guaranteed accuracy.
Role reports, sampling gaps, unknown values, lower bounds and the displayed population are preserved.
GNSS HDOP describes geometry; VAR NONE is unreported election variance.
Automatic discovery learns the local context; membership still requires the trusted PSK and fresh authentication.
Private enrollment, exact hardware identities, enrolled firmware images and raw console/pixel records are excluded.
